evidence_notes: Group-B replication/dissection of MIT's Qwen3.5-0.8B edit: the author's edits are built mechanically (mean-difference directions, probes, closed-form rank-1 terms), with no LLM deciding weights (v0.5 report, TL;DR and Sec. 3.8). Decisive tests are fixed in a dated log on GitHub before each run and only N30 was 'pre-registered publicly in v0.2', while headline findings are tagged descriptive, hence partial. Claude Opus 5.5 implemented the code, ran experiments and drafted analyses/text (Sec. 8). Sampling alone moves MIT's edit from 25% to 55%, a non-agent direction reaches 37.5%, and the dev tie did not hold on fresh problems (TL;DR 1-3); mostly single seed on 40-150-problem subsets.
